title: Tesla renames 'Full Self-Driving' to 'Tesla Assisted Driving' in Europe | TechCrunch
summary: It’s now called “Tesla Assisted Driving,” instead of “Full Self-Driving (Supervised).” It’s a big capitulation from Tesla, which has been using the “Full Self-Driving (Supervised)” name for years despite the system requiring humans to pay attention to the road and take over…
